summary: Reviewed the existing auth module after the last work session. Four code-scope findings grouped across two files: two findings on src/auth.ts (parseDate + session handler leak), one on src/session.ts (stale handler not cleared), and one on src/utils/date.ts (duplicate utility). All P1 or P2; fix-findings mode will translate these into task-sized units grouped by file.

findings.title: parseDate silently drops DD/MM/YYYY input
findings.what_wrong: Users submitting dates in DD/MM/YYYY hit a silent parse error that logs them out. parseDate only accepts YYYY-MM-DD and returns null; the caller at line 78 does not check the result and treats null as 'expired'.
findings.suggested_fix: Detect both formats explicitly; throw a typed error on unrecognized input so the caller routes to the retry dialog instead of logging the user out.
findings.evidence: src/auth.ts:42-55 shows the regex; src/auth.ts:78 shows the caller treating null as expired.

findings.title: parseDate caller at :78 treats null as expired
findings.what_wrong: The caller conflates parse failure with expiry. A typed error from parseDate would fix this at the source; the caller should still route unrecognized errors to the retry dialog, not the logout path.
findings.suggested_fix: Switch the caller onto the new typed-error branch from parseDate; map unknown-parse errors to the retry dialog.
findings.evidence: src/auth.ts:78 shows the null check falling into the logout branch.

findings.title: SIGALRM handler leaks across commands
findings.what_wrong: The session dispatch installs signal.alarm(N) but never clears it on the return path. In long-lived shells the next command inherits the stale handler and is terminated spuriously.
findings.suggested_fix: Clear the alarm and restore the previous SIGALRM handler in a finally block.
findings.evidence: src/session.ts:120 installs the alarm; no matching signal.alarm(0) in the function.

findings.title: local parseDate duplicates parseIsoDate
findings.what_wrong: Two utilities for the same job; callers will diverge. parseIsoDate already handles the ISO case with proper error typing; the local parseDate is a subset with weaker semantics.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the local parseDate; import parseIsoDate from src/utils/date.ts and switch callers.

residual_risks: Very short timeouts (under 1 second) may race with handler installation; consider minimum-timeout guard in a follow-up.
